messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: spike in 500s for /v1/embeddings (eu-west-1) — 04:02 UTC. Threshold breached by 320% over baseline.
Aisha Patel: ack  — I'm on call. grabbing logs now.
Tom Nguyen: seeing 502s + truncated outputs in traces. quick check: many requests are routed to variant 'chat-instruct-1' instead of the embed variant.
Juan Herrera: what pinned version are requests using? can we see the model mapping?
Aisha Patel: root cause hint: anchor pin for customer org 'acme-pay' points to model id `rwd-v3-anchor` which currently maps to chat variant in the alias table. but the route is /v1/embeddings so fallback should go to an embed-compatible variant.
Emily Ross: ohhh. sounds like a pin vs alias drift. did a recent release update alias mappings?
Tom Nguyen: yes, during yesterday's model onboarding the alias `rwd-v3-anchor` was reassigned to a shared model that only has chat/instruct flavors. the routing policy allowed fallback to any compatible runtime; since chat variant exists in region it was used -> incompatible outputs and 500s in our embed conversion layer.
Aisha Patel: immediate mitigation proposal: disable cross-interface fallback for embeddings route in eu-west-1, and apply a circuit breaker to stop routing to chat variants for embed requests.
runtime-bot: Suggested command: `PATCH /internal/routing/policies/{policy_id}` body: `{ "allow_cross_interface_fallback": false }`
Juan Herrera: I'm +1 on disabling cross-interface fallback. also we should pin a safe embed-only variant for the customer to stop drift.
Emily Ross: can we hotfix alias mapping back to an embed-capable model? that's lower risk than changing routing rules long-term.
Tom Nguyen: two-step: 1) disable cross-interface fallback for embeddings route (fast) 2) update alias mapping for `rwd-v3-anchor` -> `rwd-embed-v2` (hotfix) 3) add validation to rollout job to prevent alias->variant mismatch.
Aisha Patel: I'll run the patch to routing; Tom, can you do the alias swap?
Tom Nguyen: on it. applying alias swap now. command: ```
# alias update
curl -X POST https://internal-api.rwd/aliases/swap \
  -d '{ "alias": "rwd-v3-anchor", "target": "rwd-embed-v2" }' 
```
deploy-bot: Deploy started: alias-swap-hotfix by Tom Nguyen — request 8892.
Aisha Patel: routing policy patched: `allow_cross_interface_fallback=false` for embeddings route in eu-west-1. monitoring.
runtime-bot: Observability note: KV cache invalidated for alias `rwd-v3-anchor` on eu-west-1 nodes (to pick up new mapping).
Tom Nguyen: alias swap completed. verifying traces.
Emily Ross: customer impact summary for now: ~1200 requests affected in the last 15m, ~4 external tenants reported garbled embed outputs (short chat-like responses). no data loss, just semantically wrong embeddings.
Aisha Patel: error rate dropped back to baseline over last 3m. pushing to confirm no more 5xxs.
Juan Herrera: follow-ups: (1) add CI check to onboarding that ensures alias target supports all interface types expected by routing policies; (2) add an alert for alias->variant drift; (3) postmortem + timeline.
Tom Nguyen: I'll open a PR for alias validation and link the rollout job to fail on mismatch.
Emily Ross: tagging product and support to notify affected customers and offer remediation guidance. suggested message: "we briefly routed embeddings to an incompatible model variant; no data was lost, and an automated hotfix restored correct routing."
Aisha Patel: incident owner: Aisha. oncall handoff will occur in 30m to Juan. creating followup ticket INC-173210 in ops.
incident-bot: Incident updated: severity=sev2 -> mitigation in place -> creating postmortem thread.
deploy-bot: Alias-swap-hotfix finished, no rollbacks.
Tom Nguyen: small config snippet for the validation we will add: ```
# pseudo
if route.expect_interface == 'embedding' and alias.target.supports_interfaces.contains('embedding') == false:
  fail("alias target incompatible with route")
```
Aisha Patel: thanks team — marking this thread resolved for paging. leaving notes for postmortem and action items. :thumbsup:
